schedule: SHA256 of sirst-s2-20261120/ followed by the sample id, ascending bytes
batch_groups: 53 groups of 4, final group of 1, equally weighted per image within real group size
stage: original full model, free-prefix common adaptation
initialization: model weights from completed local S1, fresh AdamW optimizer
trainable_scope: same names as formal S1 load_audit.json
prediction: deterministic first argmax at every scale, CFG=1, softmax ST backward at temperature 1, global CAC; inference condition pooled before positions
layers: eval mode for all layers with autograd enabled; frozen BN statistics, DropPath off
precision: FP32 reference tokenization, FP16 autocast free rollout including decoder, FP32 loss and optimizer; TF32 off

optimizer.cac_names: cb_cond.* or vae.quantize.* among S1 trainable tensors
optimizer.decay_exemptions: same groups as original local S1

checkpoint_policy: single final checkpoint at accepted update 54, no selection; periodic optimizer snapshots for retry at updates 1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50
device_policy: single GPU preferred; relocate optimizer state or layers if needed for memory and report achieved mode
eval_protocol: train sources only, separate epoch 0 draw 0/1, first argmax, FP16, TF32 off
